title: Valid company user signs in
objective: A registered user reaches the company shell with a session bound to one company.
source: identity auth router; apps/web login page
risk_rationale: Broken login blocks every journey.
preconditions: Tenant A exists. User auth.emp.a@qa.invalid is active, email verified, password set in the disposable seed.
test_data: Email auth.emp.a@qa.invalid, password from the seed secret file, company A.
steps: 1. Open /login. 2. Enter the email and password. 3. Submit. 4. Open /app.
expected_step_results: 1. Login form is shown. 2. Fields accept input. 3. Session cookie is set. 4. Shell shows the employee name and company A.
expected_ui: No error banner. Employee navigation is visible.
expected_api: POST login returns 200 and does not include the password hash.
expected_db: A session or refresh row exists for this user. No second company membership is created.
expected_audit: Login success event if the identity module writes one; otherwise record NOT_APPLICABLE with the code path.

title: Wrong password is rejected without enumeration
objective: A bad password does not reveal whether the email exists.
risk_rationale: Account enumeration aids credential stuffing.
preconditions: Known user and an unknown email.
test_data: Known email with password 'wrong-password'; unknown email nobody@qa.invalid with the same password.
initial_db: Known user exists. Unknown email has no row.
steps: 1. Submit the known email with the wrong password. 2. Submit the unknown email. 3. Compare status, body shape, and timing bucket.
expected_step_results: Both responses are the same generic failure. Neither body contains a user id.
expected_ui: Same error message on both attempts.
expected_api: 401 for both. Body does not say 'user not found'.
expected_db: Failed-attempt counter increments only for the known user if the product stores one. Unknown email creates no user.
expected_audit: Failure recorded for the known account only.

title: Repeated failures hit the rate limit
objective: The lockout already observed in live QA still returns 429 and then recovers.
risk_rationale: Missing lockout enables online guessing.
preconditions: A disposable user whose lockout counter can be reset.
test_data: Correct email, wrong password, attempt count from the identity setting.
steps: 1. Submit wrong passwords until the limit. 2. Submit the correct password while locked. 3. Wait out or reset only this disposable user and sign in.
expected_step_results: 1. Responses become 429. 2. Correct password is still rejected while locked. 3. After the window, correct password returns 200.
expected_ui: Lockout message, not a stack trace.
expected_db: Counter returns to a state that allows login. No other user is locked.
expected_audit: Lockout event for this user only.

title: Anonymous request to a company API is rejected
objective: Company routes require a session.
risk_rationale: Missing auth exposes employee data.
preconditions: No cookie.
test_data: GET /api employee list for company A.
steps: 1. Call the employee list with no cookie and no company header.
expected_step_results: 401. Body has no employee names.
expected_db: No reads are required to be proven beyond an empty response body.

title: Disabled user cannot sign in
objective: A disabled membership loses access immediately.
risk_rationale: Disabled staff must not keep punching or reading payroll.
preconditions: User is active, then an admin disables them.
steps: 1. Sign in as the user. 2. Admin sets the user disabled. 3. Repeat a company API call with the old session. 4. Attempt a new login.
expected_step_results: 1. Login works. 2. Disable succeeds. 3. Old session is rejected. 4. New login is rejected.
expected_ui: Session ends on the next navigation.
expected_api: 401 or 403 on the old session and on the new login.
expected_db: User status is disabled. Employee row is unchanged.

title: Password reset uses the test sender only
objective: Reset creates a token and a captured message, and does not call a real SMTP host.
source: onboarding email sender sandbox; forgot-password route
risk_rationale: A real send would leave the disposable environment.
preconditions: Email backend is the logging or capture sender. Network egress to SMTP is disabled.
steps: 1. Submit forgot-password. 2. Read the captured message. 3. Open the reset link on localhost. 4. Set a new password and sign in.
expected_step_results: 1. Generic success even if the email exists. 2. Exactly one captured message. 3. Form loads. 4. New password works and the old one fails.
expected_ui: Generic confirmation, then reset form, then shell.
expected_db: One reset token, consumed after use. Password hash changed.
cleanup: Restore the seed password for later cases.

title: Expired reset token is rejected
objective: An old token cannot set a password.
risk_rationale: Long-lived tokens are account takeover.
preconditions: A token whose expiry is in the past.
test_data: Token row edited only in the disposable database.
steps: 1. POST the expired token with a new password.
expected_step_results: Rejection. Password hash unchanged.
expected_db: password hash identical before and after.

title: Missing company context is rejected
objective: A session without a selected company cannot read company data.
risk_rationale: A missing tenant filter is a cross-tenant leak.
preconditions: User belongs to company A only.
test_data: Call employee list omitting the company header or cookie the API requires.
initial_db: Company A and company B both have employees.
steps: 1. Authenticate. 2. Call the list without company context.
expected_step_results: 400 or 401. Body contains neither company's employees.
expected_ui: Company picker or error, not a mixed list.

title: User cannot select a company they do not belong to
objective: Company B's id is not a valid context for a company A user.
risk_rationale: Header spoofing must not switch tenant.
preconditions: Two tenants in the seed.
test_data: Company A admin sends company B id.
steps: 1. Sign in as A. 2. Request company B employees with B's id.
expected_step_results: 403 or 404. Zero company B rows.

title: New company registration creates five roles
objective: The supported signup path creates the tenant and the five default roles with the grants in organisation/service.py.
risk_rationale: Wrong default grants ship every later permission bug.
preconditions: Email qa.founder@qa.invalid is unused. Captured email sender.
test_data: Company name QA Foundry, founder name, password.
steps: 1. Open /register. 2. Submit the form. 3. Verify email through the captured link. 4. Sign in. 5. Read roles and role_permission.
expected_step_results: Company, founder user, and roles COMPANY_ADMIN, HR_ADMIN, REPORTING_MANAGER, BRANCH_MANAGER, EMPLOYEE exist. Founder holds COMPANY_ADMIN.
expected_ui: Setup or company home after verification.
expected_db: EMPLOYEE role includes ATTENDANCE.PUNCH, ATTENDANCE.VIEW, ATTENDANCE.REGULARIZATION_REQUEST, LEAVE.APPLICATION_SUBMIT, LEAVE.BALANCE_VIEW, PAYROLL.PAYSLIP_VIEW_OWN at SELF. HR_ADMIN has no PAYROLL.RUN_APPROVE. COMPANY_ADMIN has leave type manage and payroll approve.
cleanup: This company can be tenant A for the rest of the batch if the seed is not preloaded.

title: HR cannot create a leave type; company admin can
objective: Leave type management stays with COMPANY_ADMIN.
source: default grants; LEAVE.TYPE_MANAGE is not in the HR_ADMIN loop
risk_rationale: HR creating policy would bypass the company-admin control the grants encode.
preconditions: Tenant A seeded. No type code QA_CL.
test_data: code QA_CL, name QA Casual, paid=true.
steps: 1. Sign in as HR and POST a leave type. 2. Sign in as company admin and POST the same body. 3. Open the leave types page as each user.
expected_step_results: 1. HR receives 403 and no row. 2. Admin receives 201. 3. Admin sees QA Casual. HR page either hides the action or shows the same 403 on save.
expected_ui: Admin list contains QA Casual. HR has no successful create toast.
expected_db: Exactly one leave_type row for QA_CL in company A. Zero rows in company B.
expected_audit: Leave type created by the admin user id.
cleanup: Disable the type if later cases need a clean list; otherwise keep it.

title: Publish a casual policy with explicit rules
objective: A published version snapshots the rules applications will use.
source: LeavePolicyVersion fields; publish path in leave service
risk_rationale: Wrong snapshot makes every balance assertion meaningless.
preconditions: QA_CL type exists.
test_data: accrual NONE, annual entitlement 12.00, max_consecutive_days 5, half_day_allowed true, sandwich_rule_enabled true, reserve_balance_on_submission false, allow_negative_balance false, reason_required true, approval_chain MANAGER, year_end CARRY_FORWARD, carry cap 5.
steps: 1. Create the draft with those values. 2. Publish it. 3. Read the version back.
expected_step_results: Published version returns every value unchanged. Status is published. A second publish of the same draft is rejected.
expected_ui: Policy page shows published and the numbers above.
expected_db: One published leave_policy_version. Draft is not editable in place.
cleanup: Keep as the casual policy for application cases.

title: Negative balance without a floor is rejected
objective: Publishing allow_negative_balance without negative_balance_floor fails closed.
source: leave service publish validation around allow_negative_balance
risk_rationale: An unbounded negative balance is an unapproved loan of leave.
preconditions: A draft type QA_BAD.
steps: 1. Attempt to publish.
expected_step_results: Publish is rejected. No published version.
cleanup: Delete the draft if the API allows; else leave it unpublished.

title: Three working days debit 3.00
objective: Tue–Thu in a Mon–Fri calendar charges 3.00 and ignores nothing inside the span.
risk_rationale: Day count is the money input to payroll.
preconditions: Alice, employee of company A, branch North, calendar Mon–Fri, no holiday on 2026-06-02, 2026-06-03, 2026-06-04. Casual policy published as LEV-C02 but approval_chain AUTO for this fixture variant, opening ledger +10.00.
test_data: start=2026-06-02 end=2026-06-04 half_day empty reason 'QA three day'.
steps: 1. Employee opens leave apply. 2. Submits the range. 3. Read the application, ledger, and balance.
expected_step_results: total_days=3.00. AUTO chain approves immediately. Ledger amount -3.00. Balance 7.00.
expected_ui: Status Approved. Balance 7.00 on the leave page and on the profile leave panel.
expected_db: 3 leave_application_day rows fraction 1.00. One ledger debit -3.00. No company B row.
expected_audit: Submit and approve events with Alice's user id.
cleanup: Cancel before start if the employee may; else HR cancel. Balance returns to 10.00.
automation: API arithmetic plus one UI submit.

title: Weekend inside Mon–Fri is not charged when both weekend days sit together
objective: Prove the implemented sandwich: only a non-working day whose immediate neighbours are both consuming is charged.
risk_rationale: Clients often expect both weekend days to count. The code does not do that.
preconditions: Calendar Sat–Sun WEEKLY_OFF. Policy sandwich on. AUTO chain. Balance 10.00.
initial_db: Four dates resolve to WORKING, WEEKLY_OFF, WEEKLY_OFF, WORKING.
steps: 1. Submit Fri–Mon. 2. Read day rows.
expected_step_results: Days charged: Fri and Mon only. Sat is not sandwiched because Sunday is not consuming. Sun is not sandwiched because Saturday is not consuming. total_days=2.00. Ledger -2.00. Balance 8.00.
expected_db: Two day rows. No day row for 2026-06-06 or 2026-06-07.

title: A single weekly off between two working days is sandwiched
objective: Thu working, Fri weekly off, Sat special working charges Friday too.
risk_rationale: This is the only shape the sandwich rule implements.
preconditions: Fixture calendar where 2026-06-12 is WEEKLY_OFF and 2026-06-11 and 2026-06-13 are WORKING. Sandwich on. Balance 10.
steps: 1. Submit the range. 2. Read days and ledger.
expected_step_results: total_days=3.00 including Friday with is_sandwich_generated true. Ledger -3.00. Balance 7.00.
expected_db: Three day rows. Friday flagged sandwich.

title: Half day on one date charges 0.50
objective: Half-day is accepted only when start equals end.
source: fraction 0.50 when half_day set and start==end
risk_rationale: Half-day errors double or halve a day's pay.
preconditions: half_day_allowed true. 2026-06-02 WORKING. Balance 10. AUTO.
steps: 1. Submit the half day. 2. Submit a second request for 2026-06-02 to 2026-06-03 with half_day set.
expected_step_results: 1. total_days=0.50, ledger -0.50, balance 9.50. 2. The multi-day half-day request is rejected and does not add a second debit.
expected_ui: Balance 9.50. Second form shows a validation error.

title: Unresolved calendar fails closed
objective: A date with no work calendar is not treated as a working day.
risk_rationale: Assuming WORKING would debit leave the company never configured.
preconditions: Employee with no calendar assignment on 2026-07-01.
steps: 1. Submit that date.
expected_step_results: Error. Balance stays 10.00. No application row.
expected_ui: Message that the calendar is incomplete, not a generic 500.

title: Range longer than max consecutive days is rejected
objective: max_consecutive_days 5 blocks a 6-day span.
risk_rationale: The cap is a policy control, not a display hint.
preconditions: Policy max 5. Six working days 2026-06-15 through 2026-06-20.
steps: 1. Submit.
expected_step_results: Rejected. Balance 10. No application.

title: Exactly the available balance is approved
objective: A request for the full balance succeeds and leaves 0.00.
source: balance floor 0 when allow_negative_balance is false
risk_rationale: Off-by-one here zeroes the wrong balance.
preconditions: Balance exactly 2.00. Two working days. AUTO. No reserve.
steps: 1. Submit both days.
expected_step_results: APPROVED. Ledger -2.00. Balance 0.00.

title: One day over the balance is rejected when negative is off
objective: 3.00 requested against 2.00 does not create an application or a debit.
risk_rationale: Silent overdraft creates unpaid-leave disputes.
preconditions: Balance 2.00. Negative off. AUTO.
steps: 1. Submit three days.
expected_step_results: Rejected. Balance stays 2.00.

title: Loss-of-pay covers only the shortfall on approval
objective: When the approval path marks uncovered days as LOP, the ledger debits total_days minus lop_days.
source: set_lop_days and debit amount -(total_days-lop_days) in leave service
risk_rationale: Debiting the LOP portion double-penalises pay.
preconditions: Policy that reaches the LOP branch on approval. Balance 1.00. Request 2.00 working days. Chain MANAGER so the application exists as SUBMITTED before the decision. Confirm in this run whether submit itself allows the shortfall or only the approval shortfall path does. If submit rejects first, status of this case is BLOCKED and BR-02 records the decision.
steps: 1. Submit. 2. If submit is stored, manager approves. 3. Read lop_days and ledger.
expected_step_results: If the LOP path runs: status APPROVED, lop_days=1.00, ledger -1.00, balance 0.00. If submit rejects the shortfall: no row, and this case is BLOCKED pending BR-02 rather than forced to pass.
expected_ui: Either approved with 1 LOP day or an insufficient-balance error. Record which.
expected_api: Do not treat 200 as success unless lop_days and the ledger match.
expected_db: Ledger debit equals paid days only.
expected_audit: Comment contains loss of pay when LOP is used.

title: Pending request does not debit when reserve is off
objective: Default reserve_balance_on_submission false leaves the ledger untouched until approval.
risk_rationale: An early debit that approval also debits is a double charge.
preconditions: Chain MANAGER. reserve false. Balance 10. One working day.
steps: 1. Employee submits. 2. Read ledger before the manager acts.
expected_step_results: Status SUBMITTED. Ledger still sums to 10.00. No debit row.
expected_ui: Pending. Balance still 10, or the UI shows 10 available and 1 pending. If the UI shows 9 while the ledger is 10, file a defect for display drift.

title: Reserve on submit reduces availability and approval does not debit twice
objective: When reserve is on, the pending request holds the days and final approval keeps a single net debit.
risk_rationale: Double debit is a payroll error.
preconditions: A second policy version with reserve true and chain MANAGER. Balance 10. One working day. Manager is the snapshotted reporting manager.
steps: 1. Submit. 2. Read ledger and any reservation. 3. Manager approves once. 4. Read ledger again.
expected_step_results: After approve, net leave consumed is 1.00 and balance is 9.00. A second ledger debit of 1.00 is a failure.
cleanup: Cancel before start and confirm balance 10.

title: Overlap with a pending or approved request is blocked
objective: A second application on the same day is rejected while SUBMITTED or APPROVED exists.
risk_rationale: Two approved rows would debit twice.
preconditions: One APPROVED day on 2026-06-18 and, in a second fixture, one SUBMITTED day.
steps: 1. Submit the same date again. 2. Reject or cancel the first. 3. Submit again.
expected_step_results: 1. Rejected, no extra debit. 2. First becomes REJECTED or CANCELLED. 3. The new request is accepted.
expected_ui: Overlap error, then success after the first is closed.
expected_db: Never two APPROVED rows on that date for this employee.
expected_audit: One successful submit after the release.

title: Rejected and cancelled requests do not block a new request
objective: Only SUBMITTED and APPROVED occupy the date.
risk_rationale: A stuck rejected row would lock the employee out of leave.
preconditions: A REJECTED application on 2026-06-19.
expected_step_results: Accepted.
expected_ui: New request is pending or approved.
expected_db: New row plus the old REJECTED row.
cleanup: Cancel the new row if approved.

title: Reversed and empty ranges are rejected
objective: end before start, and a range with no consuming day, create nothing.
source: date validation and empty breakdown error
risk_rationale: A negative span could credit leave.
preconditions: Balance 10. A weekend-only range where sandwich cannot apply because there is no consuming neighbour.
steps: 1. Submit the reversed range. 2. Submit Sat–Sun.
expected_step_results: Both fail. Balance 10. No application.

title: Missing reason is rejected when reason_required
objective: The published policy's reason flag is enforced.
risk_rationale: Applications without a reason break the audit the policy asked for.
preconditions: reason_required true.
steps: 1. Submit with an empty reason.
expected_step_results: 422. No row.

title: Repeat submit of the same idempotency key does not create two rows
objective: A double click or retry returns the original application.
source: idempotency on submit where the router exposes a key; if no key exists, two rapid submits of the same date must still leave at most one open application because of the overlap rule
risk_rationale: Double submit is the normal UI failure mode.
preconditions: Balance 10. One working day free.
test_data: Same JSON body posted twice in parallel.
steps: 1. Fire two submits together. 2. Count applications and ledger debits.
expected_step_results: One open application. Net debit 0 while pending (reserve off) or 1.00 if AUTO. Never two debits.
expected_api: One 201 and one 4xx, or two 201 with the same id.

title: Reporting manager approves the snapshotted stage
objective: The manager stored on the application, not whoever currently sits above the employee, can approve a MANAGER stage.
risk_rationale: The wrong person must not move leave to approved.
preconditions: Alice reports to Maya. Chain MANAGER. Request SUBMITTED for 1.00 day. Balance 10. reserve off.
initial_db: status SUBMITTED, stage MANAGER, approver Maya's employee id.
steps: 1. Maya opens the approval inbox. 2. Approves with the current version / If-Match. 3. Read ledger.
expected_step_results: Status APPROVED. Ledger -1.00. Balance 9.00. Attendance projection written.
expected_ui: Request leaves the pending list. Alice sees Approved.
expected_db: One debit -1.00. action row by Maya's user id.

title: A different manager cannot approve
objective: Branch manager who is not the snapshotted manager is rejected even with APPLICATION_APPROVE.
source: manager stage requires caller employee id = snapshotted manager
risk_rationale: Scope permission alone must not approve another tree.
preconditions: North branch manager is not Alice's reporting manager. Alice is in North.
steps: 1. Branch manager calls approve. 2. Maya then approves.
expected_step_results: 1. 404 as the out-of-scope pattern, or 403. Status stays SUBMITTED. Ledger unchanged. 2. Maya's approve succeeds.
expected_ui: Branch manager does not see a successful toast.
expected_audit: Denial not required. Success audit names Maya only.

title: Employee cannot approve their own request
objective: Self-approval fails on a MANAGER chain.
source: caller employee id must equal the manager id
risk_rationale: Self-approval is the classic leave control failure.
preconditions: Alice's own SUBMITTED request. Alice does not also hold the manager id.
test_data: Alice's token and the application id.
steps: 1. Alice calls the approve endpoint.
expected_step_results: Rejected. Status SUBMITTED. Balance 10.
expected_ui: No approve control on her own request, and the direct call still fails.

title: Company B approver cannot decide company A leave
objective: Cross-tenant application id is invisible.
risk_rationale: Guessed UUID must not approve another company's leave.
preconditions: Two tenants. Application belongs to A.
test_data: B admin token, A's application id, B company context.
steps: 1. B calls approve, reject, and cancel with A's id.
expected_step_results: All three fail. A's status and ledger unchanged.

title: Missing manager falls through to HR
objective: effective_stage_sequence drops a missing manager and the HR stage can finish the request.
risk_rationale: A missing manager must not strand leave forever, and must not let a random user approve it.
preconditions: Chain MANAGER. Employee has null reporting manager so the stage resolves to HR. Balance 10. One day.
test_data: HR user with LEAVE.APPLICATION_APPROVE at COMPANY.
steps: 1. Confirm the stored stage is HR. 2. HR approves.
expected_step_results: APPROVED. Ledger -1.00. Balance 9.00.
expected_ui: HR inbox shows the request. Employee sees Approved.
expected_db: approver is the HR user, debit -1.00.

title: Manager-then-HR needs both decisions and debits once
objective: First approval only advances the stage.
risk_rationale: Debiting at the intermediate stage and again at the end doubles the charge.
preconditions: Chain MANAGER_THEN_HR. Balance 10. One working day. reserve off.
steps: 1. Maya approves. 2. Read ledger and status. 3. HR approves. 4. Read ledger.
expected_step_results: After Maya: still SUBMITTED, stage HR, ledger sum 10. After HR: APPROVED, ledger -1.00, balance 9.00.
expected_db: One debit only, after the second call.

title: Reject with reason leaves the ledger unchanged
objective: Rejection from SUBMITTED does not debit.
risk_rationale: A debit on rejection takes leave the employee did not use.
preconditions: SUBMITTED, reserve off, balance 10.
steps: 1. Maya rejects with the reason.
expected_step_results: REJECTED. Ledger 10. The date is free for a new request.
expected_audit: Reject with reason and Maya's user id.

title: Stale If-Match does not approve
objective: Optimistic concurrency blocks a decision on an old version.
risk_rationale: A stale approve can override a cancel.
preconditions: SUBMITTED version N.
test_data: If-Match N-1, then a valid N.
steps: 1. Approve with N-1. 2. Approve with N.
expected_step_results: 1. 409. Status unchanged. 2. APPROVED and a single debit.
expected_ui: Conflict message, then success on refresh.

title: Two approvers at once produce one decision
objective: Parallel approve calls do not double-debit.
source: version check; live QA double-approve result
risk_rationale: Double debit is a P0 money defect.
preconditions: One SUBMITTED row. Balance 10.
test_data: Two parallel approves with the same version.
steps: 1. Send both approves. 2. Sum the ledger.
expected_step_results: One success and one conflict. Balance 9.00. Not 8.00.

title: Approve after cancel does not debit
objective: A decision loses to a cancel that committed first.
risk_rationale: Approving a cancelled request grants leave the employee withdrew.
preconditions: SUBMITTED.
steps: 1. Employee cancels. 2. Manager approves with the pre-cancel version.
expected_step_results: Final status CANCELLED. Ledger 10. Approve returns conflict or not-found state.

title: Reject after approve does not credit or debit
objective: Terminal APPROVED is not rejectable.
risk_rationale: A late reject could erase an approved debit incorrectly.
preconditions: APPROVED, ledger already -1.00, balance 9.
steps: 1. Manager rejects.
expected_step_results: Error. Status stays APPROVED. Balance stays 9.00.
cleanup: Cancel through the cancel path if restoration is required.

title: Employee withdraws a pending request
objective: Cancel of SUBMITTED is the product's withdrawal. There is no WITHDRAWN status.
risk_rationale: A stuck pending request blocks the dates.
preconditions: Alice's SUBMITTED request. reserve off.
steps: 1. Alice cancels from the leave list.
expected_step_results: Status CANCELLED. Ledger 10. Date is free.
expected_ui: Cancelled. Not a separate Withdrawn label unless the UI renames it.

title: Employee cancels approved leave before it starts and the debit reverses
objective: Balance returns to the pre-approval figure.
source: cancel of APPROVED before start by the employee
risk_rationale: Missing reversal steals leave.
preconditions: APPROVED future date. Ledger went from 10.00 to 9.00.
test_data: start date tomorrow or later in the fixture clock.
steps: 1. Alice cancels. 2. Sum the ledger. 3. Check attendance projection.
expected_step_results: CANCELLED. A credit +1.00. Balance 10.00. Projection removed.

title: Employee cannot cancel approved leave after it has started
objective: After the start date only APPLICATION_CANCEL_APPROVED may cancel, and it requires a reason.
risk_rationale: Back-dating a cancel rewrites attendance and pay.
preconditions: APPROVED leave whose start date is today or earlier. Balance 9.
steps: 1. Alice cancels.
expected_step_results: Rejected. Status APPROVED. Balance 9.00.

title: HR cancels started leave with a reason and restores the debit
objective: The authorised reversal credits total_days minus lop_days.
risk_rationale: Wrong credit amount corrupts the ledger.
preconditions: APPROVED started leave, debit was -1.00, balance 9.00. HR holds CANCEL_APPROVED. Company admin is not required.
steps: 1. HR cancels without a reason. 2. HR cancels with a reason.
expected_step_results: 1. Rejected, balance 9. 2. CANCELLED, credit +1.00, balance 10.00.

title: Second cancel does not credit again
objective: Duplicate cancel is idempotent or a conflict, never a second credit.
source: status must be SUBMITTED or APPROVED
risk_rationale: A second credit mints leave.
preconditions: After LEV-C34 style cancel, balance 10.
steps: 1. Cancel again.
expected_step_results: Error. Balance stays 10.00.

title: Another employee cannot cancel Alice's request
objective: Self-scope cancel does not accept a different employee id.
risk_rationale: Any employee could wipe a colleague's leave.
preconditions: Bob is a second employee. Alice has SUBMITTED leave.
steps: 1. Bob calls cancel.
expected_step_results: 404 or 403. Alice's row stays SUBMITTED.
expected_ui: Bob's list does not show Alice's request.

title: Displayed balance equals the ledger sum
objective: Profile, leave page, and API balance are the same number.
source: balance is the sum of the append-only ledger
risk_rationale: Screens that disagree cause employees to apply against a fictional balance.
steps: 1. Open profile leave panel. 2. Open leave balances. 3. GET the balance API.
expected_step_results: All three show 8.00.

title: HR adjustment in company scope writes a reasoned ledger row
objective: Manual adjust changes the balance by the exact amount.
risk_rationale: Adjustments are unaudited money if the reason is optional in practice.
preconditions: HR has BALANCE_ADJUST. Alice balance 8.00.
steps: 1. Adjust. 2. Read balance. 3. Repeat the same request if an idempotency key is supported.
expected_step_results: Balance 9.50. A repeated key does not make 11.00. Employee role cannot call this.
expected_ui: HR sees 9.50. Alice sees 9.50 and cannot open the adjust control.
cleanup: Adjust -1.50 with reason 'test reversal' if the suite must restore 8.00.

title: Manager cannot adjust a balance outside the granted action
objective: BALANCE_VIEW_ALL does not imply BALANCE_ADJUST.
source: HR grant includes adjust; reporting manager grant includes view all at tree scope but the adjust code is on HR
risk_rationale: Managers rewriting balances bypass HR control.
preconditions: Maya can see Alice's balance.
steps: 1. Maya calls adjust.
expected_step_results: 403. Balance 8.00.

title: Year-end carry keeps the cap and lapses the rest
objective: CARRY_FORWARD with cap 5 turns a balance of 8.00 into 5.00.
source: year-end mode on the policy version
risk_rationale: Year-end is an irreversible bulk ledger write.
